changelog.body:
## 简体中文

## r13.14.3 — 2026-11-18

`versionCode 144`，基于 `r13.14.2 / 143` 的 Android 13 维护更新。

### 修复与兼容

- 校准浮动通知的隐藏计时、自动展开、居中和下滑手势。静音过滤保留来电与闹钟等全屏通知的原生判定。
- 修正通知抽屉自动展开、解锁后锁屏通知保留、单应用通知上限和简约折叠视图。状态栏恢复隐藏三点溢出提示的选项，图标数量切回默认时恢复 ROM 原生限制。
- 按 SystemUI 插件实际使用的 ClassLoader 安装控制中心和音量 Hook。音量面板的自定义隐藏时长沿用系统无障碍换算。
- 校准桌面长按应用信息、文件夹宽度、旋转动画和充电唤醒入口。自定义状态栏高度同步到窗口策略。来电不中断功能安装前核对 ROM 的调用者字段和回调返回类型。
- 将快捷方式图标处理移到后台线程。页面重建或后台进程被回收后，可恢复已收到且仍在缓存中的选择，并在页面恢复后回传。
- 默认英文应用名为「Customiuizer A13」，简体和繁体中文为「米客 A13」。关于页面补充源码、正式版本、支持入口和兼容说明。
- 将构建工具链更新至 Gradle 9.9.1、AGP 9.5.0 和 Temurin 25.0.5，更新构建依赖并清理失效的设置页入口。

### 验证与已知限制

目标为 MIUI 14 / Android 13，HyperOS 1 / Android 13 为实验兼容。要求 libxposed API 102 和 `arm64-v8a`。沿用 `r13.14.2` 正式签名证书。

本轮依据 ROM 样本与构建检查验证，A13 实机验收待补。若后台恢复时快捷方式缓存已被清除，可能需要退出选择器后重进并重新选择。

## English

## r13.14.3 — 2026-11-18

`versionCode 144`, an Android 13 maintenance update over `r13.14.2 / 143`.

### Fixes and compatibility

- Refine heads-up notification timeout, automatic expansion, positioning, and swipe gestures. Muted-mode filtering preserves the system's handling of full-screen notifications such as calls and alarms.
- Fix automatic expansion in the notification shade, lock-screen notification retention after unlocking, per-app notification limits, and the compact collapsed view. Restore the three-dot overflow toggle and the ROM's icon limits when the icon count returns to Default.
- Install Control Center and volume hooks through the class loader used by the SystemUI plugin. Custom volume panel timeouts use the system's accessibility adjustment.
- Refine the Launcher app-info shortcut, folder width, rotation animations, and charging wake behavior. Apply the configured status bar height to window policy. Call interruption filtering validates the ROM caller field and callback return type before installing hooks.
- Process shortcut icons in the background. The picker can recover a cached selection after the screen is recreated or the background process is reclaimed, then deliver it when the screen resumes.
- Use Customiuizer A13 as the default English app name and 米客 A13 in Simplified and Traditional Chinese. About includes source, release, support, and compatibility information.
- Update to Gradle 9.9.1, AGP 9.5.0, and Temurin 25.0.5. Update build dependencies and remove unused settings entry points.

### Verification and known limitations

Targets MIUI 14 on Android 13. HyperOS 1 on Android 13 remains experimental. Requires libxposed API 102 and `arm64-v8a`. Uses the same release signing certificate as `r13.14.2`.

Verification for this update covers ROM samples and build checks. A13 device acceptance is pending. If Android clears a shortcut selection's cache while the app is in the background, reopen the picker and select the shortcut again.

## Build / 构建

[Source / 源码](https://github.com/thetvplus/customiuizer-a13/commit/99f3f4b9f658ca5f594e117a00c039288dabdc57) · [Signed build](https://github.com/thetvplus/customiuizer-a13/actions/runs/44293994663/attempts/1)

APK checksums and attestation are retained in the original build artifact.
APK 校验和及来源证明保留于原始构建产物。

changelog.name: r13.14.2
changelog.body:
## 简体中文

## r13.14.2 — 2026-11-17

`versionCode 143`，基于 `r13.14.1 / 142` 的 Android 13 维护更新；不新增功能。

### 修复与兼容

- **双排信号（#19）**：恢复并保留 96 个信号图标资源。为两个 SystemUI 控制器使用独立可变列表及状态副本，不再覆盖原生 `strengthId`；根据宿主隐藏规则、单卡、空卡、飞行模式与漫游状态回退。视图更新与明暗重着色时恢复原生 drawable 和可见性，重复绘制结果不再写入图标。
- **扩展电源菜单（#14）**：恢复 MAML 原始资源，检查 ZIP 完整性与加载前置条件；资源无效或替换安装失败时保留原生电源菜单路径。
- **安全中心应用信息（#14）**：将应用详情、复制路径、Play Store 与启动操作绑定到当前 Fragment、Activity 和 PackageInfo，移除跨页面全局引用与多余延迟投递。相关入口已在 xaga SecurityCenter 8.0.4 与 veux 8.9.4 样本中定向核对。
- **锁屏音乐可视化（#14）**：首次挂载时读取当前媒体控制器、封面和显示状态；面板替换时重新同步，控制器使用弱引用，缺失屏幕回调时保留媒体事件回退，部分 Hook 安装失败时撤销已装回调。
- 精简测试、Agent 与工程文档的重复规则，改进变更影响选测及 ROM / DEX 证据边界；保持现有偏好键、备份格式和设置迁移行为。

### 验证与已知限制

静态检查、JVM 测试、Lint、R8 及无正式签名 APK 打包检查已通过；最终候选资源表保留 96 个信号图标和逐字节一致的 MAML ZIP。**本次未完成 A13 设备验收**，#19、#14 仍待双卡切换、SystemUI 重建、MAML 交接、可视化首次显示与面板替换验证。SecurityCenter 11.1.6 和部分损坏的 veux SystemUI DEX 不在已确认兼容范围；不将其他 ROM 样本结果外推。

目标为 MIUI 14 / Android 13；HyperOS 1 / Android 13 为实验兼容。要求 libxposed API 102 与 `arm64-v8a`。保持与 `r13.14.1 / 142` 相同的正式发布证书，可正常覆盖升级；从使用旧证书的 `r13.12.2` 升级仍需先导出备份、卸载旧版后恢复。

## English

## r13.14.2 — 2026-11-17

`versionCode 143`, an Android 13 maintenance update over `r13.14.1 / 142` with no new features.

### Fixes and compatibility

- **Dual-row mobile signal (#19):** Restore and retain all 96 signal drawables. Use controller-specific mutable lists and copies of host icon states without changing native `strengthId`. Respect host visibility rules and fall back to native handling for single/absent SIMs, airplane mode, and roaming. Restore native drawables and visibility before view updates and dark-mode recoloring; skip redundant image writes.
- **Extended power menu (#14):** Restore the original MAML resource, verify ZIP integrity and prerequisites, and preserve the native power menu if resource preparation or replacement installation fails.
- **SecurityCenter app details (#14):** Bind app info, path copying, Play Store links, and app launch actions to the current Fragment, Activity, and PackageInfo; remove global cross-screen references and unnecessary deferred posts. Targeted ROM evidence covers xaga SecurityCenter 8.0.4 and veux 8.9.4.
- **Lock-screen music visualizer (#14):** Read the current media controller, artwork, and display state at first attachment; resynchronize after panel replacement. Use weak references, retain media-event fallback when screen callbacks are unavailable, and roll back partially installed Hooks.
- Consolidate redundant testing, agent, and engineering-document rules, improve change-scoped checks and ROM / DEX evidence limits, and preserve existing preference keys, backups, and settings migration behavior.

### Verification and known limitations

Static checks, JVM tests, Lint, R8, and unsigned APK packaging checks passed. The final candidate resource table contains all 96 signal drawables and a byte-identical MAML ZIP. **No A13 on-device acceptance was completed.** Issues #19 and #14 still require validation of SIM switching, SystemUI recreation, MAML handoff, initial visualizer display, and panel replacement. SecurityCenter 11.1.6 and affected corrupt veux SystemUI DEX entries are outside verified compatibility scope; results from other ROMs are not generalized.

Targets MIUI 14 / Android 13; HyperOS 1 / Android 13 remains experimental. Requires libxposed API 102 and `arm64-v8a`. The official release keeps the certificate used by `r13.14.1 / 142` for in-place upgrades. Migrating from `r13.12.2` with the older certificate still requires exporting settings, uninstalling, reinstalling, and restoring the backup.

## Build / 构建

[Source / 源码](https://github.com/thetvplus/customiuizer-a13/commit/86e4b2983fda37900775637cc4159847b82db132) · [Signed build](https://github.com/thetvplus/customiuizer-a13/actions/runs/44056884611/attempts/1)

changelog.name: r13.13.0
changelog.body:
米客 A13｜CustoMIUIzer A13 · r13.13.0 · versionCode 141

## 简体中文

- 修复长偏好键导致设置备份失败的问题（[Issue #12](https://github.com/thetvplus/customiuizer-a13/issues/12)）。
- 修复来电过滤、通知渠道设置跳转与多用户归属。
- 统一 Hook 安装、Service 连接和偏好监听的生命周期，处理重复注册、初始化竞争与失败状态。
- 全面使用 libxposed API 102，更新构建工具链，精简重复脚本和历史文档。

> **签名已变更，不能直接覆盖旧版。** 原 A13 发布密钥目前无法取得。请先将设置备份成功导出到下载或文档目录，再卸载旧版、安装新版、恢复备份，重新启用模块并重启。备份失败时请保留旧版。

需要 **MIUI 14 / Android 13、arm64-v8a、libxposed API 102**。HyperOS 1 / Android 13 仍为实验兼容；仅提供 API 101 的框架不再受支持。

静态检查、单元测试、lint、R8 与 CI 已通过；本版尚未完成 A13 实机验收。

## English

- Fixed settings backup failing on long preference keys ([Issue #12](https://github.com/thetvplus/customiuizer-a13/issues/12)).
- Fixed call filtering, notification-channel settings navigation and user selection.
- Unified hook installation, service binding and preference-listener lifecycles to address duplicate registration, initialization races and failure states.
- Moved fully to libxposed API 102, updated the build toolchain and removed duplicate scripts and historical documents.

> **The signing certificate changed; older builds cannot be updated in place.** The previous A13 key is currently unavailable. Successfully export settings to Downloads or Documents before uninstalling, then install this build, restore settings, re-enable the module and reboot. Keep the old app if backup fails.

Requires **MIUI 14 / Android 13, arm64-v8a and libxposed API 102**. HyperOS 1 / Android 13 remains experimental; API 101-only frameworks are no longer supported.

Static checks, unit tests, lint, R8 and CI passed. This version has not completed A13 device acceptance.

# CustoMIUIzer A13 r13.12.2

> 维护状态：本项目已停止主动开发，维护者已转向其他系统。当前版本继续作为 MIUI 14 / Android 13 的稳定维护版本保留。

适用于 MIUI 14 / Android 13 与 HyperOS 1 / Android 13。

`r13.12.2` 已包含并取代 `r13.12.0` / `r13.12.1`：

- 完成 r13.12.1 未完全覆盖的 Activity 选择结果两跳回传路径；
- 修复 `MultiAction -> AppSelector -> ActivitySelector -> AppSelector -> MultiAction` 中回栈中继结果丢失；
- 修复自定义动作/桌面手势保存后回到“无动作”的问题；
- 桌面手势页补齐“重启桌面”入口；
- USB 默认用途在拔线后重新插上会再次应用；
- 新增/改进：USB 默认用途映射、安装器净化、隐藏应用详情举报入口、Dock 高度、隐藏输入法关闭按钮、文件夹模糊开关、设置备份 V2、电池指示条自定义颜色、息屏变暗比例。

下载校验：

- 签名证书 SHA-256：`15CE32F03E4D8E62DF9390F77431862E59BF2CF95CD5A72F0C7330CDFCCA2934`

静态门禁、Release 编译、Lint、R8 与签名 APK 检查已通过；无 ADB，不声明实机或 MIUI/HyperOS 运行时已验证。

---

> Maintenance status: Active development has ended as the maintainer has moved to other systems. The project remains available as a stable maintenance build for MIUI 14 / Android 13.

For MIUI 14 / Android 13 and HyperOS 1 / Android 13.

`r13.12.2` supersedes `r13.12.0` / `r13.12.1`:

- Completes the Activity-selection relay path left incomplete by r13.12.1;
- Fixes `MultiAction -> AppSelector -> ActivitySelector -> AppSelector -> MultiAction` dropping the returned Activity choice;
- Fixes custom/gesture actions snapping back to "No action";
- Adds Restart Launcher on the Launcher gesture page;
- USB default mode reapplies after unplug/replug;
- Adds/improves USB default-mode mapping, installer purify, hide app-details report entry, dock height, hide IME dismiss button, folder blur toggle, settings backup V2, battery indicator custom colors, and screen-dim ratio.

Static gates, Release compile, Lint, R8, and signed APK inspection passed; no ADB, so on-device or MIUI/HyperOS runtime verification is not claimed.

changelog.name: r13.11.1
changelog.body:
## CustoMIUIzer A13 r13.11.1

适用于 MIUI 14 / Android 13，并为 HyperOS 1 / Android 13 提供基于系统能力探测的兼容路径。

### 本版本主要更新

- 加固设置页延迟滚动与界面销毁时的生命周期处理，避免已销毁 View 收到延迟回调。
- 优化 AppSelector / ActivitySelector 异步加载生命周期，减少 Activity / View 持有和过期结果回写。
- 优化状态栏时钟默认格式处理路径，缓存稳定的格式转换结果和资源解析结果，减少每次时间刷新时的重复处理。
- 保留当前系统时间格式、12/24 小时制、秒钟、AM/PM、前导零以及自定义格式行为。
- 延续 r13.10.1 的进程级安装、ROM Contract、异常边界、生命周期和性能治理。

### 兼容性

- 主要目标：MIUI 14 / Android 13。
- HyperOS 1 / Android 13 的部分 SystemUI 功能取决于具体 ROM 与系统应用版本；目标类不存在时，对应功能可能不可用，但不会阻止模块其他功能加载。
- 不支持 Android 14 及以上版本。
- 需要 Root 和 LSPosed / Vector。

### 安装

安装 APK 后，在 LSPosed / Vector 中启用模块并确认作用域，然后完整重启设备。

### APK SHA-256

\\\
398A274F89FB7A3DA6FB22F9D89058B737C7B1B6AE3E0192FD1F9CA71B1FAE9A
\\\

注：由于后续个人设备将转向类原生 / AOSP 系统，A13 分支预计不再继续主动维护；如有必要，可能仅处理严重 Bug 或兼容性问题。
